_comment: Manual ticker fixes for names the model tends to mis-resolve. bySymbol keys are UPPERCASE tickers the model might emit; byCompany keys are lowercased substrings matched against the extracted company name. Both map to the correct Yahoo Finance symbol. Extend as the audit finds more.
_trusted_comment: Symbols whose ticker is unambiguous but whose extracted 'company' is often a description/nickname (e.g. QQQ as 'Nasdaq-100'). Name validation is skipped for these to avoid false rejections. Override targets are also auto-trusted.
